main_measure.name: mean demeaned per-bar gain (forecast/10 x next-bar return minus window mean daily return)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 40 active bars

supporting_check.name: larger-short half minus smaller-short half mean demeaned gain

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2 with at least 40 active bars, so it neither confirms nor rejects.
reading: The 20-bar mean volume includes the current bar and is computed inside each window, so active bars in the first 19 rows of a window are left out of the situation check; the window's mean daily return is the mean of all its next-bar close-to-close returns; for the supporting check, active bars are sorted by forecast, and with an odd count the middle bar is dropped.
